title: Public Alert No. 035/2026 – Alert on the Marketing and Sale of Unregistered Menofix Composition
summary: NAFDAC warns that Menofix Capsules, marketed by PureEve as a herbal/multivitamin supplement for menopause, is not registered with NAFDAC. Some ingredients are linked to rare liver injury. It differs from similarly named registered Menofix products. Avoid sale or use.
